title: lantern cove
summary: A pop-up paper fishing village at golden hour. Every hut, palm, boat and crab lies flat on the page until the camera reaches it, then folds up on its hinge. Built in three.js with the papercraft agent skill.
medium: 3d paper diorama, three.js, rendered headless to video

specs.camera: one slow pan from the jetty past the lighthouse and the huts to the kid on the boardwalk, turning 20° as it goes
specs.fold-up: every piece starts flat and rises on a springy hinge the moment it enters the frame; nothing folds back down
specs.pieces: ~800 printed cards: 4 fishing huts, a lighthouse, palms, dune grass, rocks, nets, crates, buoys, sailboats, crabs, gulls and a kid in a yellow raincoat
specs.assets: none, every card is cut and printed by code when the scene builds; no image generation
specs.life: gulls crossing, chimney smoke, cloud shadows, bobbing boats, crabs and gulls that wander
specs.renderer: three.js r187 in headless chromium (software gl), one frame at a time on a fixed clock
specs.live scene: /a/019-lantern-cove/scene/ (walk with wasd or arrows; add ?pan for the fold-up pan)
specs.made with: the papercraft agent skill by xikhar (MIT), github.com/xikhar/papercraft: its paper kit and harness; the world, palette and pieces are new
